articles.title: Multiple transport trucks involved in crash on Hwy. 403 in Burlington
articles.summary: No injuries were reported after a multi-vehicle crash on Highway 403 in Burlington early Tuesday morning. The westbound QEW ramp to Highway 403 in Burlington has reopened.

articles.title: 2 bodies found in 2 vehicles set on fire in Scarborough and Etobicoke: police
articles.summary: Toronto police say two bodies were found in separate burnt vehicles in Scarborough and Etobicoke overnight Monday. articles.title: 18 injured in suspected arson at Mississauga apartment building
articles.summary: Residents in a Mississauga apartment building are shaken after a fire Monday morning, which police say may have been arson, sent at least 18 people to the hospital, including a firefighter and a police officer.

articles.title: 1 person injured in North York car crash
articles.summary: One person was sent to a hospital late Monday afternoon following a car crash in North York. Emergency crews were called to the area of Islington and Steeles Avenues just before 5:30 p.m. for reports of a two-vehicle collision. Police said the airbags of the vehicles deployed and that the drivers remained at the scene. […]

articles.title: Man, 19, facing charges for allegedly threatening to carry out a shooting at a Durham Region synagogue
articles.summary: A 19-year-old man is facing charges for allegedly threatening to carry out a shooting at a synagogue in Durham Region. Durham police say they received information on Friday from an extrernal law enforcement partner about threats made on an online message board. The messages were alleged threats to commit a shooting at a synagogue. After […]

articles.title: 2 dead after shooting outside Scarborough seniors' medical centre: police
articles.summary: Two people are dead following a shooting outside a seniors’ medical centre in Scarborough Monday afternoon, Toronto police say.

articles.title: Peel Regional Police Association endorses Alvin Tedjo in Mississauga mayoral race
articles.summary: The association is endorsing a candidate in Mississauga’s municipal campaign for what the organization says is the first time in its history. The Peel police union's president said Monday that Tedjo "understands that public safety is not just a slogan, it's a responsibility."

articles.title: Ontario launches project to refurbish 4 nuclear reactors at Pickering plant
articles.summary: An Ontario nuclear plant is beginning a massive refurbishment project today, as Premier Doug Ford's government looks to lean heavily on nuclear energy to serve the province's growing electricity needs.
